content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"This judge text governs a link-level collision by comparing the defender's and challenger's chains rather than requiring one pressed verse to state the contrary.","verdict":"CLEAN","quote":"D5 vs C1 (Acts 2:30): UNDERDETERMINED -- [CR2] and [CR3] answered the loins/seed row with Genesis 46:26 and Hebrews 7:10 (loins at depth) and the legal/flesh distinction, while [DR3] presses that the only named Davidic man is Joseph; neither chain forces the other.","rule_words":"When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; I weighed whether the judge compared whole chains by footing or isolated verses one by one.","why":"The judge text compares the defender's chain (loins-at-depth and legal/flesh distinction) with the challenger's chain (only named Davidic man is Joseph) and calls the result underdetermined, which is chain-against-chain weighing rather than the retired verse-by-verse stating-verse test."}
